caption:
How to summarize any meeting in 3 lines with AI

Long meeting notes don't get read. Three lines do.

Copy this:

"Summarize these meeting notes in exactly 3 lines: 1) What we decided. 2) Who does what, by when. 3) What's still open. No intro. Notes: [PASTE NOTES]"

I tried it on messy notes from an invented bakery team meeting. It pulled out the one decision (close at 2pm on Dec 24), the two actions with owners, and the open question about who posts on social media. It even noticed Jo's task had no deadline.

Tip: add "Flag any action with no deadline" so you know what to chase. Remove anything confidential before you paste.

Send this to someone who still types up meeting notes by hand. Follow @nomorebusywork for one fix a day.

Save this for later. 📌
